question.text: As per SEBI (Research Analysts) Regulations, 2014, research analysts are required to maintain all records for a minimum period of how many years?

explanation.text: The Logic: All records maintained by the research analyst or research entity shall be preserved for a minimum period of five years, whether in physical or electronic form. The Trap: 7 years is the period stock exchanges retain the historical UCC database; it is not the RA record-retention period and should not be conflated with it. Note: Electronic records should carry digital signatures as required by the regulations.
